title: Steady Beat · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Steady Beat · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose one player as the timekeeper. The timekeeper taps a steady gentle beat and the lead joins for eight taps. The lead stays with the beat for all eight taps, as judged by the group. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Steady Beat, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead stays with the beat for all eight taps, as judged by the group.
recall.why: The lead stays with the beat for all eight taps, as judged by the group.
